newsitem.title: JAPAN: Trade in Ricoh shares bustles in morning session.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Ricoh shares bustles in morning session.

text.p: Trade in Ricoh Co Ltd bustled in Thursday's morning session as investors decided that demand for the shares was lagging behind that of other bellwether issues, brokers said.

At 0153 GMT, the shares were 50 yen higher at 1,270 yen, staying abreast of their high for the year. It was the most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange in volume of 4.154 million.
"It's a little behind the other blue-chips and both domestic and foreign investors are attracted to it," a broker at one of Japan's "Big Four" brokerages said.
